|gprice = 700 |value = 100 |stats = {{Name|Defense|+2}} }} '''Work Boots''' are a [[footwear]] item in Stardew Valley. They can be found in [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] after reaching [[Fishing#Fishing Skill|Fishing level 2]]. They are a possible reward for the chest on floor 10 of [[The Mines]] if "remixed" mine rewards are selected in the [[Options|Advanced Options]] menu when starting a new game.
